text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I see Mejiro Dober buying
essential oils
in bulk at the mall.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Lavender helps with falling asleep...
Cypress helps
with relaxation...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Eucalyptus aids with concentration...
And rose
and lemongrass...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should just get one of
everything. It's
starting to look like I
need them all...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober seems extremely tired.
Maybe it's
best to ease off of racing for
now.
